title: video-edit clip candidates
description: <outdir>/candidates.json, written by the session beside candidates.md (references/reels.md section 4). The Clips tab shows one card per candidate, sorted by total score; ids must be unique and end must be after start.

id.description: Stable id; pick rows name the candidate by it.

speaker.description: Who carries the clip: a transcript speaker label or a name.

hook.description: The first spoken line, or the headline the session would add.

excerpt.description: The transcript of the span, or its first lines.

scores.description: 1-5 on each axis of references/reels.md section 4.

why.description: The session's reasoning for the scores.
